name: Trimeperidine
summary: Trimeperidine, sold under the brand name Promedol, is an opioid analgesic that is an analogue of prodine. It was developed in the early 1950s in the Soviet Union during research into the related drug pethidine.

pharmacology.text: Trimeperidine increases the activity of the reticular activating system in the brain.

uses.text: Trimeperidine, sold under the brand name Promedol, is an opioid analgesic that is an analogue of prodine. It is around half the potency of morphine as an analgesic, and has been widely used for the treatment of pain. Promedol is included into the standard medication kit, which is carried on the battlefield by every Russian military personnel, as a pain-killer in case of wounding.

sideEffects.text: Trimeperidine produces similar effects to other opioids, such as analgesia and sedation, along with side effects such as nausea, itching, vomiting, and respiratory depression, which may be harmful or fatal.

summaryZh: 三甲利定（英語：trimeperidine）是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C17H25NO2，屬於類阿片化合物，是阿法羅定的同系物。20世紀50年代初由蘇聯研究哌替啶相關藥物時開發。
